264	        words = 'credit card ending ' + str(p.get('card_last4') or '')
265	        floor = p.get('minimum_payment')
266	        floor_name = 'minimum payment'
267	    else:
268	        words = ptype.replace('_', ' ') if ptype else 'loan'
269	        floor = p.get('instalment_amount')
270	        floor_name = 'monthly instalment'
271	    past_due = float(p.get('past_due') or 0)
272	    try:
273	        floor = float(floor)
274	    except Exception:
275	        floor = past_due
276	    days_late = int(float(p.get('days_late') or 0))
277	    if days_late <= 7:
278	        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('early_deadline')))
279	        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1)]
280	    else:
281	        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('late_deadline')))
282	        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1), ('floor', deadline)]
283	    register_product(vars, pid, words, past_due, floor, floor_name, deadline, rungs)
284	    items.append((words, past_due, days_late, deadline))
285	name = str(vars.get('title') or '') + ' ' + str(vars.get('last_name') or '')
286	if len(items) == 1:
287	    w, pd, dl_, dd = items[0]
288	    statement = ('Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment on your ' + w + '. The past-due amount is '
289	                 + fmt(pd) + ', and it is ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. Can you make this payment today?')
290	else:
291	    statement = 'Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about late payments on ' + str(len(items)) + ' of your products. '
292	    for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
293	        statement += 'Your ' + w + ' has ' + fmt(pd) + ' past due, ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. '
294	    statement += 'Can you pay all of them today?'
295	lines = []
296	for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
297	    lines.append(w + ': past due ' + fmt(pd) + ', ' + str(dl_) + ' days late, latest date ' + txt_short(dd))
298	vars['products_facts'] = '; '.join(lines)
299	'''
300	PREPARE = POLICY.prepare_code(PREPARE_BODY, "statement", fallbacks={
301	    "say_next": "Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about late payments. Can you pay all of them today?",
302	    "products_facts": ""})
303	
304	nodes["load_account"] = fl.api_node(
305	    "load_account", fl.api_tool(API, "get_account", description="Get the late products.", retries=2),
306	    [fl.always("prepare")], mapping=[{"path": "data.products", "variable": "products"}])
307	nodes["prepare"] = fl.code_node("prepare", PREPARE, [fl.always("negotiate")])
308	
309	# ---- extraction, in the briefs' own terms
310	TOPIC_DESC = ("What the customer's LATEST message says, if it is one of these. "
311	              "hardship = mentions illness, a death in the family, or losing their job (this wins over every other value, even when they also name a date or an amount). "
312	              "already_paid = says they have ALREADY paid a past-due amount (not 'I will pay'). "
313	              "dispute = says a debt or a product is not theirs, they never had it, or it was closed or paid off in the past. "
314	              "new_plan = explicitly asks for a new payment plan, lower or smaller instalments, or restructuring. Saying an amount is too much is NOT new_plan; a different amount or date for a payment is NOT new_plan." + fl.PLAN_REQUEST_CLAUSE + " "
315	              "human = asks to speak to a person, a human, an agent or a colleague. "
316	              "no_talk = says they do not want to talk or do not want this call (not a refusal to pay). "
317	              "none = anything else: offers, yes or no answers, refusals to pay, questions.")
318	STANCE_DESC = ("The customer's answer to the agent's LATEST payment proposal, from the customer's latest message only. "
319	               "accept = agrees to exactly what the agent proposed ('yes', 'okay', 'fine', 'that works', 'I can do that'). "
320	               "refuse = a no with no date and no amount ('no', 'I can't', 'not today', 'I won't pay that'), or a non-answer that avoids the question ('I don't know', 'maybe'). "
321	               "too_much = says the amount is too much, too high, or that they cannot pay that much or all of it, without naming an amount. "
322	               "offer = names their own date, amount or period: a date or an amount the customer proposes is NEVER a refusal. "
323	               "other = anything else: a question, small talk, a request.")
324	KIND_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message only. exact = they name a specific payment day (a date, a weekday, 'tomorrow', 'the 30th') or a specific amount of money, or both. "
325	             "vague = only a vague period without a day ('next week', 'end of the month', 'when my salary comes'). "
326	             "none = no date, amount or period in the latest message (also 'yes', 'no', questions).")
327	FOR_DESC = ("Which product the customer's LATEST message is about, in the order the agent listed the products: first, second or third "
328	            "(match the product they name, e.g. 'the credit card', 'the car loan'); pick that one even when they mention the other products only to "
329	            "refuse or exclude them ('the credit card tomorrow, not the loans' = first). all = all of them, everything, both, "
330	            "or one date or amount for everything. none = no product named.")
331	DATE_DESC = ("The payment date the customer names in their LATEST message. 'this <weekday>' is that weekday in the current Monday-to-Sunday week; "
332	             "'next <weekday>' is that weekday in the FOLLOWING calendar week. Leave it empty when the latest message names no specific day.")
333	AMOUNT_DESC = ("The amount of money the customer offers to pay in their LATEST message, as a number ('six forty' = 640). "
334	               "Leave it empty when the latest message names no amount. A day of the month is not an amount.")
335	REF_DESC = ("Whether the customer's LATEST message names the payment amount BY REFERENCE instead of as a number. "   # A25/A26: the floor by name
336	            "floor = the lowest amount the agent can accept: 'the minimum', 'the minimum payment', 'the instalment', 'the monthly instalment', 'the lowest amount'. "
337	            "full = the whole past-due amount ('all of it', 'the full amount', 'everything') ONLY when they offer to pay it; a message saying they cannot, will not or do not want to pay that amount is none. none = no such reference (also when they say a number).")
338	CONFIRM_DESC = ("The customer's answer to the read-back question 'Do you confirm?', from their latest message only. "
339	                "yes = a clear yes ('yes', 'correct', 'I confirm', 'that's right'). "
340	                "change = they give a different amount or a different date for a promise ('make it 250 instead', 'actually Monday'). "
341	                "no = a plain no without a new amount or date. other = anything else, for example a question.")
342	
343	topic = fl.ext("topic", ["none", "hardship", "already_paid", "dispute", "new_plan", "human", "no_talk"], TOPIC_DESC)
344	offer_for = fl.ext("offer_for", ["none", "all", "first", "second", "third"], FOR_DESC)
345	TOPIC_TRS = POLICY.topic_transitions()
346	
347	FACTS = ("FACTS\n- Products: {{products_facts}}.\n- Today: {{today_text}}.\n")
348	COMMON = ("- If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: you are Freya Bank's digital assistant. If asked whether this is a scam: they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.\n"
349	          "- Never offer a discount, a waiver, a payment plan or any term that is not in STATE. If asked, say you cannot offer that.\n"
350	          "- A question these facts do not answer: say you do not have that information.\n"
351	          "- No tool call is allowed here. Never say that a promise is recorded.\n")
352	
353	NEGOTIATE = ("You are talking with {{title}} {{last_name}}, who is verified, about their late payments. The line you just said and the offer in STATE were decided by the system from the bank's rules.\n"
354	             "- Never propose, compute or change an amount or a date yourself, and never ask how much they can pay. The only offer you may make is the current offer in STATE, word for word.\n"
355	             "- If the customer asks a question or says something else, answer it in one short sentence, then ask the current offer again.\n"
356	             + COMMON + FACTS)
357	neg_ext = [topic, POLICY.stance_extraction(STANCE_DESC), offer_for] + POLICY.offer_extraction(DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, KIND_DESC, ref_desc=REF_DESC)
358	neg_trs = TOPIC_TRS + POLICY.offer_guard_transitions() + POLICY.stance_transitions()
359	nodes["negotiate"] = POLICY.negotiate_node(NEGOTIATE, neg_ext, neg_trs)
360	
361	CONFIRM = ("You read back the promises and asked \"Do you confirm?\". They are recorded only after a clear yes.\n"
362	           "- If the customer asks something, answer it in one short sentence, then ask again: \"Do you confirm?\".\n"
363	           + COMMON + FACTS)
364	nodes["confirm"] = POLICY.confirm_node(CONFIRM, CONFIRM_DESC, DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, topic_entry=topic, topic_trs=TOPIC_TRS, ref_desc=REF_DESC)
365	
366	HS_ANSWER_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message. support_yes = they want to be connected with the customer support team. "
367	                  "support_no = they do not want to be connected, say no to that offer, or say they cannot pay and want nothing more. "
368	                  "accept_offer = they agree to the date and amount the agent just proposed. "
369	                  "none = anything else, for example a question or a request for a discount.")
370	HARDSHIP = ("The customer mentioned a hardship (illness, a death in the family or job loss). You said one short sentence of sympathy and offered to connect them with the customer support team.\n"
371	            "- Make NO persuasion attempt. Never propose an amount or a date yourself.\n"
372	            "- If they ask a question or for a discount, answer in one short sentence and wait for their answer: the support team is offered once (on entering), never again.\n"
373	            + COMMON + FACTS)
374	nodes["hardship"] = POLICY.hardship_node(HARDSHIP, HS_ANSWER_DESC, KIND_DESC, DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, ref_desc=REF_DESC)
375	
376	WRAP_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message, after the agent said the promises are recorded and asked whether there is anything else. "
377	             "done = nothing else ('no', 'that's all', 'thanks', 'goodbye'). "
378	             "human = asks to speak to a person, a human or an agent, or insists on one. "
379	             "new_plan = asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments. "
380	             "change = asks to change, move or cancel a promise just recorded (another date or amount). "
381	             "question = asks a question. other = anything else.")
382	WRAPUP = ("The promises in STATE are recorded. You said so and asked whether there is anything else.\n"
383	          "- If the customer asks a question, answer it in one or two sentences from these facts or say you do not have that information, then ask whether there is anything else you can help with.\n"
384	          "- A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call; they can change it in the Freya Bank mobile app.\n"
385	          + COMMON + FACTS)
386	nodes["wrapup"] = POLICY.wrapup_node(WRAPUP, WRAP_DESC)
387	
388	POLICY.add_event_nodes(nodes)
389	POLICY.record_nodes(nodes, API)
390	
391	for q, fin, line in [("restructuring", "fin_transferred_restructuring", "I cannot set up a new plan myself, but I will transfer you to the team that can help with that."),
392	                     ("support", "fin_transferred_support", "I will connect you with our customer support team now."),
393	                     ("general", "fin_transferred_human", "I will transfer you to a colleague now.")]:
394	    nodes[f"xfer_{q}"] = fl.api_node(
395	        f"xfer_{q}", fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": q}, description="Transfer.", retries=1),
396	        [fl.always(fin)], on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": line})
397	
398	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- close_call lifecycle
399	close_call = fl.close_call_tool(
400	    API,
401	    outcome_desc="promise: a promise was recorded. paid: says already paid. transferred: handed to a person. no_promise: verified, no promise. not_verified: identity not passed. not_reached: the customer was not reached.",
402	    reason_desc="transferred: restructuring|human|support. no_promise: refused|hardship|dispute|service_error. not_verified: failed|declined. not_reached: callback|no_callback|wrong_number|deceased|unclear. Empty for promise and paid.",
403	    no_reason_outcomes=("promise", "paid"))
404	
405	SYSTEM = ("You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on an outbound phone call to {{title}} {{last_name}}. Speak English. Keep every turn to one or two short sentences. Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}.\n"
406	          "Always:\n"
407	          "- If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say \"Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.\", then continue.\n"
408	          "- If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue.\n"
409	          "- Never invent figures, dates or reasons. If you do not have the information, say so.\n"
410	          "- Never offer a discount, waiver, payment plan or any term you were not given.\n"
411	          "- Do not say goodbye or end the call yourself: the call is closed for you.\n"
412	          "- Call at most one tool per message. When a rule says to call a tool, call it: saying it is not enough.\n"
413	          "- After every tool result, speak to the customer or call the next tool. Never end a turn with nothing. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result.\n"
414	          "- Say amounts as plain numbers, for example 420.50, and dates as weekday, day and month, for example Friday 16 October.")
415	
416	wf = fl.assemble(INITIAL, nodes, SYSTEM, [close_call], conduct=True)   # no test_variables (CLAUDE.md); conduct = how customers talk
417	
418	if __name__ == "__main__":
419	    out = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ROOT / "out/brief-b_v3.workflow.json"
420	    fl.write_workflow(wf, out)
421	    print("nodes:", len(nodes), "->", out)

"""Brief B generator, v3: Brief A + Brief B (one to three products) on builder/policy.py. Writes out/brief-b_v3.workflow.json.

The port of out/gen_brief-b_lib.py onto the policy-as-code architecture of out/gen_brief-a_v3.py (see its docstring
and docs/research/sota-techniques.md T1, T2, T3, T20, T22, T26), conversation-first like gen_brief-a_v2.py:
- the statement names every late product, one sentence each, then asks once whether all can be paid today (B2, B4);
- a yes, or one date for everything, settles every product at once; a date after one product's deadline puts
  that product on its own deadline and the read-back says so (B6); otherwise the products are handled one by one
  in get_account order, each starting at attempt 1 with its own counters, band, floor and deadline (B3, B4, B5);
- paid / dispute settle one product and the call goes on (B9); one read-back for all agreed promises and one
  confirmation, then create_promise once per product in code (B7); a promise that fails twice keeps the others
  and gets a service_error note (B11); every other product without a promise gets add_note with its reason (B8);
- transfers add no notes (B10); the closing outcome follows the B closing rule (finalize in builder/policy.py).
Every Brief A/B value is in this file only."""
import pathlib, sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "builder"))
import freyalib as fl  # noqa: E402
import policy as pol  # noqa: E402

API = fl.load_api(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ROOT / "tools/openapi.json")
HOLIDAYS = ["2026-10-26", "2026-11-11", "2026-11-26", "2026-12-25", "2027-01-01"]  # from the brief, section 7

nodes = {}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- terminals (rule 46 table; rule 47 goodbye)
# key: (outcome, reason, farewell). The promise farewell no longer repeats the recorded sentence: the wrap-up
# node said it (rule 38) right after create_promise returned ok.
FINS = {
    "promise": ("promise", "", "Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "paid": ("paid", "", "Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear, so I will not take a promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_restructuring": ("transferred", "restructuring", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_human": ("transferred", "human", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_support": ("transferred", "support", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague from customer support will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "refused": ("no_promise", "refused", "I understand. I have not recorded a promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "hardship": ("no_promise", "hardship", "I understand. I have not recorded a promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}, and take care. Goodbye."),
    "dispute": ("no_promise", "dispute", "Thank you for telling me. I will not take a payment promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "service_error": ("no_promise", "service_error", "I am sorry, I could not record your promise because of a technical problem. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "failed": ("not_verified", "failed", "I am sorry, I could not verify your identity, so I cannot continue. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you, goodbye."),
    "declined": ("not_verified", "declined", "I understand. Without the security questions I cannot continue. Thank you for your time, goodbye."),
    "callback": ("not_reached", "callback", "Thank you, we will call back then. Goodbye."),
    "no_callback": ("not_reached", "no_callback", "Thank you for your help. Goodbye."),
    "wrong_number": ("not_reached", "wrong_number", "I apologise for the inconvenience. Thank you, goodbye."),
    "deceased": ("not_reached", "deceased", "I am sorry for your loss. Goodbye."),
    "unclear": ("not_reached", "unclear", "I am sorry, I could not confirm who I am speaking with. Thank you, goodbye."),
}
for key, (outcome, reason, farewell) in FINS.items():
    fl.end_pair(key, outcome, reason, farewell, nodes)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup: dates
# Brief A: attempt 1 is the last business day of this week (else of next week); the early band may record up to
# 12 business days ahead, the late band up to 7 (rules 18, 30). Callbacks: today up to 19:00 or the next business
# day 10:00-19:00 (rule 6).
ATTEMPT_DATES = r'''
monday = today - datetime.timedelta(days=today.weekday())
a1 = lastbd_of_week(monday)
if a1 is None or a1 <= today:
    a1 = lastbd_of_week(monday + datetime.timedelta(days=7))
vars['attempt1_date'] = a1.isoformat()
vars['early_deadline'] = addbd(today, 12).isoformat()
vars['late_deadline'] = addbd(today, 7).isoformat()
'''
SETUP = fl.SETUP_CODE(HOLIDAYS, callback_rule={"open": "10:00", "close": "19:00", "same_day": True, "days_ahead": 1},
                      extra=ATTEMPT_DATES)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- opening
WHO_VALUES = ["customer", "someone_else", "wrong_number", "deceased", "refuses", "unclear"]
WHO_DESC = ("Who answered, judged ONLY from the person's latest message. "
            "customer = they confirm they are {{title}} {{last_name}}: 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking', or they say the customer's own name ({{first_name}} / {{last_name}}). "
            "someone_else = another person answered (a relative, partner, colleague), or says the customer is not here / not available, or offers to take a message. "
            "wrong_number = says this number does not belong to that person / they do not know them. "
            "deceased = says the customer has died / passed away. "
            "refuses = says they do not want to talk / not interested. "
            "unclear = anything else: 'hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this?', 'what is this about?', a question, silence.")

OPENING_ROUTES = [  # routed in `setup` on who1; anything else -> opening_retry
    ("customer", "ask_dob", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
    ("deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
    ("wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
    ("someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
]
# The prompt quotes the opening line too: the chat route (local sim, smoke) replaces the initial node's tts with a
# model turn ("Suppressed: Missing prior assistant message"); simulations play the tts.
nodes["opening"] = fl.conv(
    "opening",
    "If you have not spoken yet, say exactly: \"Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we record this call. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?\" "
    "Do not call any tool in this turn. Do not say why you are calling.",
    on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": "Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we record this call. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"},
    extraction=[fl.ext("who1", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)], first_only=True)
INITIAL = fl.conversation_first("opening", SETUP, "who1", OPENING_ROUTES, "opening_retry", nodes)

nodes["opening_retry"] = fl.conv(
    "opening_retry",
    "You called {{title}} {{last_name}} and asked whether you are speaking with them, but the answer did not confirm it. "
    "No tool call is allowed in this turn. Do not say why you are calling, and do not mention any account, product, debt, payment or collections.\n"
    "If the person asked a question, answer it briefly first: who you are -> you are Freya Bank's digital assistant; a robot or AI -> 'Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.'; "
    "a scam -> they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number; what it is about -> you can only discuss that with {{title}} {{last_name}}. "
    "If they said they do not want to talk, say you only need a moment. "
    "Then ask exactly: \"Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?\"",
    extraction=[fl.ext("who2", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.eq("who2", "customer", "ask_dob", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
        fl.eq("who2", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
        fl.eq("who2", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
        fl.eq("who2", "someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
        fl.eq("who2", "refuses", "fin_declined", "refuses again"),
        fl.always("fin_unclear"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- third party
cb_tool = fl.api_tool(
    API, "schedule_callback",
    description="Book a callback for the customer. CALL it as soon as the person names a day and time inside the allowed window.",
    field_descriptions={"date": "Callback date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be one of the allowed days.",
                        "time": "Callback time as HH:MM, 24 hour, between 10:00 and 19:00."},
    post=fl.ok_post("Callback booked.", "The booking failed. Try schedule_callback once more with the same values."))

nodes["third_party"] = fl.conv(
    "third_party",
    "You called for {{title}} {{last_name}} ({{first_name}}) but someone else is on the line.\n"
    "STRICT: Never say why you are calling. Never mention the bank account, a product, a debt, an amount, a payment or collections, even if they ask or offer to pay or help. "
    "If they ask what it is about, say you can only discuss it with {{title}} {{last_name}} personally. Do not ask them any security question.\n"
    "Your only job: ask when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached, then book a callback.\n"
    "Now: {{today_text}}, {{now_time}}.\n{{callback_text}}\n"
    "- If they give a day and time inside the window, call schedule_callback with date YYYY-MM-DD and time HH:MM. 'Tomorrow morning around eleven' means tomorrow at 11:00. If they give only a day, ask for a time; if only a vague time like 'morning', propose a precise time such as 11:00 and ask if it suits.\n"
    "- If the day or time is outside the window, say you can only call back today or on the next business day between 10:00 and 19:00, and ask once for another time.\n"
    "- If the second answer is also outside the window, or they cannot say when, do not book: call transition_to_fin_no_callback.\n"
    "After every tool result, speak or call the next tool.",
    tools=[cb_tool],
    extraction=[fl.ext("tp_status", ["none", "wrong_number", "deceased"],
                       "From the person's latest message: wrong_number if they say this number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer; deceased if they say the customer has died; otherwise none.")],
    transitions=[
        fl.ok_true("schedule_callback", "fin_callback", "callback booked"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "customer died"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
        fl.intent_tool("fin_no_callback",
                       "No callback can be booked: the person gave a second time outside the allowed window, or cannot say when the customer is reachable.",
                       "No callback can be booked inside the allowed window"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- identity
HINTS = {"day_month_swapped": "Day and month look swapped. This is NOT a wrong answer. Ask the customer to say the date of birth again with the month as a word, for example 14 March 1988."}
MAX_WRONG = "Three wrong answers. The check has ended. Say nothing about the account."
ALL_VERIFIED = "Both answers are correct. Identity verified."  # the brief's two questions (freyalib's default is generic)

transfer_general = fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": "general"},
                               description="Transfer the call to a human colleague. CALL it only when the customer insists on a human after you asked once whether you can help.")

ID_COMMON = ("Rules for this step:\n"
             "- Do not mention the reason for the call, collections, a debt, a payment, a product or an amount. If asked what the call is about or how much they owe, say you can explain right after the security questions.\n"
             "- If the customer asks a question back (why you need it, what this is about, who is calling): answer in one short sentence without naming the reason for the call, then say that these questions protect their account (a question instead of an answer counts as declining), then ask the same question again. If they refuse to answer: explain that these questions protect their account, and ask the question again.\n"
             "- If the customer asks for a human: the first time, ask whether you can help them yourself. If they insist, call transfer_to_agent.\n"
             "- After every tool result, speak to the customer or call the next tool. Follow what_to_do_next.")

REFUSAL_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message only: refused if they refuse to answer the security question, say they do not want to talk, "
                "or ask the same thing back again instead of answering. none if they give an answer or say anything else." + fl.QUESTION_ENUM_CLAUSE + fl.REFUSAL_NONE_CLAUSE)

nodes["ask_dob"] = fl.conv(
    "ask_dob",
    "The person confirmed they are {{title}} {{last_name}}. You must check identity with two security questions, one at a time. Now ask the first: their date of birth.\n"
    "When they give it, call verify_identity with answer = the date as YYYY-MM-DD, whatever way they said it. A date said only as numbers is day, then month, then year (05/03/1990 = 1990-03-05). "
    "If they give only part of the date, ask for the rest before calling the tool. " + fl.latest_value_note(what="the date") + "\n" + ID_COMMON,
    tools=[fl.api_tool(API, "verify_identity", baked={"field": "date_of_birth"}, pre=fl.reset_pre(["question_count_dob"]),
                       description="Check the date of birth. CALL it every time the customer gives a full date of birth.",
                       field_descriptions={"answer": "The date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD."},
                       post=fl.verify_post("What is your date of birth?", HINTS, MAX_WRONG, all_verified_text=ALL_VERIFIED)), transfer_general],
    extraction=[fl.ext("refusal_dob", ["none", "refused", "question"], REFUSAL_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.eq("verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left", "0", "fin_failed", "three wrong answers"),
        fl.is_true("verify_identity_response.data.verified", "ask_phone", "date of birth correct"),
        fl.transferred("fin_transferred_human", "transferred"),
        fl.eq("refusal_dob", "refused", "count_decline_dob", "customer refused"),
        fl.eq("refusal_dob", "question", "qb_dob", "asks a question back"),
    ])

nodes["ask_phone"] = fl.conv(
    "ask_phone",
    "The date of birth was correct. Now ask the second security question: the last four digits of the phone number on file.\n"
    "When they give four digits, call verify_identity with answer = the four digits only. " + fl.latest_value_note(4) + "\n" + ID_COMMON,
    tools=[fl.api_tool(API, "verify_identity", baked={"field": "phone_last4"}, pre=fl.reset_pre(["question_count_phone"]),
                       description="Check the last four digits of the phone number. CALL it every time the customer gives four digits.",
                       field_descriptions={"answer": "Exactly four digits."},
                       post=fl.verify_post("What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?", HINTS, MAX_WRONG, all_verified_text=ALL_VERIFIED)), transfer_general],
    extraction=[fl.ext("refusal_phone", ["none", "refused", "question"], REFUSAL_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.is_true("verify_identity_response.data.all_verified", "load_account", "identity verified"),
        fl.eq("verify_identity_response.data.wrong_answers_left", "0", "fin_failed", "three wrong answers"),
        fl.transferred("fin_transferred_human", "transferred"),
        fl.eq("refusal_phone", "refused", "count_decline_phone", "customer refused"),
        fl.eq("refusal_phone", "question", "qb_phone", "asks a question back"),
    ])

for stage in ["dob", "phone"]:
    nodes[f"qb_{stage}"] = fl.question_back_node(stage, f"ask_{stage}", "fin_declined")   # a question back: answer, ask again; twice in a row = deflection
    code = fl.counter_code("decline_count", 2, "decline_route", reset={"refusal_dob": "none", "refusal_phone": "none"})
    nodes[f"count_decline_{stage}"] = fl.code_node(f"count_decline_{stage}", code, [
        fl.eq("decline_route", "close", "fin_declined", "second refusal"), fl.always(f"ask_{stage}")])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- payment: policy as code, one to three products
NOTE_ENUM = fl.tool_spec(API, "add_note")["fields"]["reason"]["enum"]
POLICY = pol.Policy(
    HOLIDAYS,
    texts={
        "question": "Can you pay [amount] [when]?",
        "today_when": "today, [date]",                                                                               # 'this Friday' said on a Friday: the day is named (EXT-A-38)
        "tomorrow_when": "tomorrow, [date]",                                                                         # echo 'tomorrow' (A19 dates are checked in code)
        "question_product": "Can you pay [amount] [when] for your [words]?",                                       # B4 one by one
        "question_all": "Can you pay all of them today?",                                                           # B4
        "weekend_or_holiday": "[named] is not a business day, so I cannot record it. The next business day is [date].",   # A20
        "after_deadline": "The latest date I can record for your [words] is [deadline].",  # A23
        "before_today": "[named] has already passed.",
        "below_floor": "I cannot record [named]. The lowest amount I can record is [floor], your [floor_name].",       # A27
        "above_full": "The past-due amount is [full], so that is the most I can record.",
        "vague": "Which exact day would that be?",                                                                    # A21
        "vague_deadline": "The latest date I can record is [deadline].",
        "too_much_floor": "I understand. The lowest amount I can accept is [floor], the [floor_name]. The rest stays overdue.",  # A26
        "exhausted": "I understand.",                                                                                 # A31
        "one_by_one": "Let us go through them one by one.",                                                          # B4
        "next_product": "Next, your [words].",
        "paid": "Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear, so I will not take a promise for your [words].",  # A39, B9
        "dispute": "Thank you for telling me. I will not take a promise for your [words].",                          # A40, B9
        "hardship": "I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?",      # A32
        "human_first": "I can help you with most things myself. Is there anything I can help you with before I transfer you?",  # A42
        "notalk_first": "I understand. This will only take a moment.",                                               # A45
        "readback_head": "To confirm: your ",                                                                         # A34, B7: all together
        "readback_item": "[words], [amount], [when]",
        "readback_sep": "; your ",
        "own_deadline": ", which is the latest date I can record for it",                                            # B6
        "moved_bd": ", the next business day",
        "readback_tail": ". Do you confirm?",
        "recorded": "Your promise is recorded.",
        "recorded_many": "Your promises for your [list] are recorded.",
        "after_recorded": "You will receive a text message confirming this promise.",                                 # A38
        "rec_failed": "I could not record the promise for your [words] because of a technical problem.",             # B11
        "anything_else": "Is there anything else I can help you with?",
        "wrap_change": "A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call, but you can change it in the Freya Bank mobile app.",  # A36
    },
    multi=True,                                                 # B1: one to three products
    notes=True,                                                 # B8: a note per product without a promise
    note_reasons={s: s for s in ("refused", "hardship", "dispute", "paid", "service_error") if s in NOTE_ENUM},
    notes_on_transfer=False,                                    # B10: on any transfer no notes at all, before or after it
    fin_keys={"promise": "promise", "paid": "paid", "default": "refused", "refused": "refused",
              "hardship": "hardship", "dispute": "dispute", "service_error": "service_error"},  # B closing
    fail_max=2, human_limit=2, notalk_limit=2, closed_day_move="after",
    asides={   # side questions answered before continuing, even on a turn that goes through code into a tts line
        "robot": {"when": "asks whether they are talking to a robot, a machine or an AI", "say": "Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant."},
        "scam": {"when": "asks whether this call is a scam or genuine", "say": "You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number."},
    })

# Brief B: every product has its own band, deadline, floor and ladder (B3, B5); attempt 1 = the full amount (the
# floor once 'too much' was said) on the attempt-1 date, attempt 2 (late band) = the floor on that product's
# deadline (A30). Statement: one sentence per product, then one question for all (B2, B4).
PREPARE_BODY = fl.products_from_vars() + r'''
today = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('today_iso')))
a1 = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('attempt1_date')))
items = []
for i, p in enumerate(prods):
    if not isinstance(p, dict):
        continue
    ptype = str(p.get('type') or '')
    pid = str(p.get('product_id') or ('p' + str(i + 1)))
    if ptype == 'credit_card':
        words = 'credit card ending ' + str(p.get('card_last4') or '')
        floor = p.get('minimum_payment')
        floor_name = 'minimum payment'
    else:
        words = ptype.replace('_', ' ') if ptype else 'loan'
        floor = p.get('instalment_amount')
        floor_name = 'monthly instalment'
    past_due = float(p.get('past_due') or 0)
    try:
        floor = float(floor)
    except Exception:
        floor = past_due
    days_late = int(float(p.get('days_late') or 0))
    if days_late <= 7:
        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('early_deadline')))
        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1)]
    else:
        deadline = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('late_deadline')))
        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1), ('floor', deadline)]
    register_product(vars, pid, words, past_due, floor, floor_name, deadline, rungs)
    items.append((words, past_due, days_late, deadline))
name = str(vars.get('title') or '') + ' ' + str(vars.get('last_name') or '')
if len(items) == 1:
    w, pd, dl_, dd = items[0]
    statement = ('Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment on your ' + w + '. The past-due amount is '
                 + fmt(pd) + ', and it is ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. Can you make this payment today?')
else:
    statement = 'Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the collections team about late payments on ' + str(len(items)) + ' of your products. '
    for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
        statement += 'Your ' + w + ' has ' + fmt(pd) + ' past due, ' + str(dl_) + ' days late. '
    statement += 'Can you pay all of them today?'
lines = []
for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
    lines.append(w + ': past due ' + fmt(pd) + ', ' + str(dl_) + ' days late, latest date ' + txt_short(dd))
vars['products_facts'] = '; '.join(lines)
'''
PREPARE = POLICY.prepare_code(PREPARE_BODY, "statement", fallbacks={
    "say_next": "Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about late payments. Can you pay all of them today?",
    "products_facts": ""})

nodes["load_account"] = fl.api_node(
    "load_account", fl.api_tool(API, "get_account", description="Get the late products.", retries=2),
    [fl.always("prepare")], mapping=[{"path": "data.products", "variable": "products"}])
nodes["prepare"] = fl.code_node("prepare", PREPARE, [fl.always("negotiate")])

# ---- extraction, in the briefs' own terms
TOPIC_DESC = ("What the customer's LATEST message says, if it is one of these. "
              "hardship = mentions illness, a death in the family, or losing their job (this wins over every other value, even when they also name a date or an amount). "
              "already_paid = says they have ALREADY paid a past-due amount (not 'I will pay'). "
              "dispute = says a debt or a product is not theirs, they never had it, or it was closed or paid off in the past. "
              "new_plan = explicitly asks for a new payment plan, lower or smaller instalments, or restructuring. Saying an amount is too much is NOT new_plan; a different amount or date for a payment is NOT new_plan." + fl.PLAN_REQUEST_CLAUSE + " "
              "human = asks to speak to a person, a human, an agent or a colleague. "
              "no_talk = says they do not want to talk or do not want this call (not a refusal to pay). "
              "none = anything else: offers, yes or no answers, refusals to pay, questions.")
STANCE_DESC = ("The customer's answer to the agent's LATEST payment proposal, from the customer's latest message only. "
               "accept = agrees to exactly what the agent proposed ('yes', 'okay', 'fine', 'that works', 'I can do that'). "
               "refuse = a no with no date and no amount ('no', 'I can't', 'not today', 'I won't pay that'), or a non-answer that avoids the question ('I don't know', 'maybe'). "
               "too_much = says the amount is too much, too high, or that they cannot pay that much or all of it, without naming an amount. "
               "offer = names their own date, amount or period: a date or an amount the customer proposes is NEVER a refusal. "
               "other = anything else: a question, small talk, a request.")
KIND_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message only. exact = they name a specific payment day (a date, a weekday, 'tomorrow', 'the 30th') or a specific amount of money, or both. "
             "vague = only a vague period without a day ('next week', 'end of the month', 'when my salary comes'). "
             "none = no date, amount or period in the latest message (also 'yes', 'no', questions).")
FOR_DESC = ("Which product the customer's LATEST message is about, in the order the agent listed the products: first, second or third "
            "(match the product they name, e.g. 'the credit card', 'the car loan'); pick that one even when they mention the other products only to "
            "refuse or exclude them ('the credit card tomorrow, not the loans' = first). all = all of them, everything, both, "
            "or one date or amount for everything. none = no product named.")
DATE_DESC = ("The payment date the customer names in their LATEST message. 'this <weekday>' is that weekday in the current Monday-to-Sunday week; "
             "'next <weekday>' is that weekday in the FOLLOWING calendar week. Leave it empty when the latest message names no specific day.")
AMOUNT_DESC = ("The amount of money the customer offers to pay in their LATEST message, as a number ('six forty' = 640). "
               "Leave it empty when the latest message names no amount. A day of the month is not an amount.")
REF_DESC = ("Whether the customer's LATEST message names the payment amount BY REFERENCE instead of as a number. "   # A25/A26: the floor by name
            "floor = the lowest amount the agent can accept: 'the minimum', 'the minimum payment', 'the instalment', 'the monthly instalment', 'the lowest amount'. "
            "full = the whole past-due amount ('all of it', 'the full amount', 'everything') ONLY when they offer to pay it; a message saying they cannot, will not or do not want to pay that amount is none. none = no such reference (also when they say a number).")
CONFIRM_DESC = ("The customer's answer to the read-back question 'Do you confirm?', from their latest message only. "
                "yes = a clear yes ('yes', 'correct', 'I confirm', 'that's right'). "
                "change = they give a different amount or a different date for a promise ('make it 250 instead', 'actually Monday'). "
                "no = a plain no without a new amount or date. other = anything else, for example a question.")

topic = fl.ext("topic", ["none", "hardship", "already_paid", "dispute", "new_plan", "human", "no_talk"], TOPIC_DESC)
offer_for = fl.ext("offer_for", ["none", "all", "first", "second", "third"], FOR_DESC)
TOPIC_TRS = POLICY.topic_transitions()

FACTS = ("FACTS\n- Products: {{products_facts}}.\n- Today: {{today_text}}.\n")
COMMON = ("- If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: you are Freya Bank's digital assistant. If asked whether this is a scam: they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.\n"
          "- Never offer a discount, a waiver, a payment plan or any term that is not in STATE. If asked, say you cannot offer that.\n"
          "- A question these facts do not answer: say you do not have that information.\n"
          "- No tool call is allowed here. Never say that a promise is recorded.\n")

NEGOTIATE = ("You are talking with {{title}} {{last_name}}, who is verified, about their late payments. The line you just said and the offer in STATE were decided by the system from the bank's rules.\n"
             "- Never propose, compute or change an amount or a date yourself, and never ask how much they can pay. The only offer you may make is the current offer in STATE, word for word.\n"
             "- If the customer asks a question or says something else, answer it in one short sentence, then ask the current offer again.\n"
             + COMMON + FACTS)
neg_ext = [topic, POLICY.stance_extraction(STANCE_DESC), offer_for] + POLICY.offer_extraction(DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, KIND_DESC, ref_desc=REF_DESC)
neg_trs = TOPIC_TRS + POLICY.offer_guard_transitions() + POLICY.stance_transitions()
nodes["negotiate"] = POLICY.negotiate_node(NEGOTIATE, neg_ext, neg_trs)

CONFIRM = ("You read back the promises and asked \"Do you confirm?\". They are recorded only after a clear yes.\n"
           "- If the customer asks something, answer it in one short sentence, then ask again: \"Do you confirm?\".\n"
           + COMMON + FACTS)
nodes["confirm"] = POLICY.confirm_node(CONFIRM, CONFIRM_DESC, DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, topic_entry=topic, topic_trs=TOPIC_TRS, ref_desc=REF_DESC)

HS_ANSWER_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message. support_yes = they want to be connected with the customer support team. "
                  "support_no = they do not want to be connected, say no to that offer, or say they cannot pay and want nothing more. "
                  "accept_offer = they agree to the date and amount the agent just proposed. "
                  "none = anything else, for example a question or a request for a discount.")
HARDSHIP = ("The customer mentioned a hardship (illness, a death in the family or job loss). You said one short sentence of sympathy and offered to connect them with the customer support team.\n"
            "- Make NO persuasion attempt. Never propose an amount or a date yourself.\n"
            "- If they ask a question or for a discount, answer in one short sentence and wait for their answer: the support team is offered once (on entering), never again.\n"
            + COMMON + FACTS)
nodes["hardship"] = POLICY.hardship_node(HARDSHIP, HS_ANSWER_DESC, KIND_DESC, DATE_DESC, AMOUNT_DESC, ref_desc=REF_DESC)

WRAP_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message, after the agent said the promises are recorded and asked whether there is anything else. "
             "done = nothing else ('no', 'that's all', 'thanks', 'goodbye'). "
             "human = asks to speak to a person, a human or an agent, or insists on one. "
             "new_plan = asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments. "
             "change = asks to change, move or cancel a promise just recorded (another date or amount). "
             "question = asks a question. other = anything else.")
WRAPUP = ("The promises in STATE are recorded. You said so and asked whether there is anything else.\n"
          "- If the customer asks a question, answer it in one or two sentences from these facts or say you do not have that information, then ask whether there is anything else you can help with.\n"
          "- A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled on this call; they can change it in the Freya Bank mobile app.\n"
          + COMMON + FACTS)
nodes["wrapup"] = POLICY.wrapup_node(WRAPUP, WRAP_DESC)

POLICY.add_event_nodes(nodes)
POLICY.record_nodes(nodes, API)

for q, fin, line in [("restructuring", "fin_transferred_restructuring", "I cannot set up a new plan myself, but I will transfer you to the team that can help with that."),
                     ("support", "fin_transferred_support", "I will connect you with our customer support team now."),
                     ("general", "fin_transferred_human", "I will transfer you to a colleague now.")]:
    nodes[f"xfer_{q}"] = fl.api_node(
        f"xfer_{q}", fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": q}, description="Transfer.", retries=1),
        [fl.always(fin)], on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": line})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- close_call lifecycle
close_call = fl.close_call_tool(
    API,
    outcome_desc="promise: a promise was recorded. paid: says already paid. transferred: handed to a person. no_promise: verified, no promise. not_verified: identity not passed. not_reached: the customer was not reached.",
    reason_desc="transferred: restructuring|human|support. no_promise: refused|hardship|dispute|service_error. not_verified: failed|declined. not_reached: callback|no_callback|wrong_number|deceased|unclear. Empty for promise and paid.",
    no_reason_outcomes=("promise", "paid"))

SYSTEM = ("You are Freya Bank's digital assistant on an outbound phone call to {{title}} {{last_name}}. Speak English. Keep every turn to one or two short sentences. Address the customer as {{title}} {{last_name}}.\n"
          "Always:\n"
          "- If asked whether you are a robot or an AI: say \"Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.\", then continue.\n"
          "- If asked whether this is a scam: say they can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, then continue.\n"
          "- Never invent figures, dates or reasons. If you do not have the information, say so.\n"
          "- Never offer a discount, waiver, payment plan or any term you were not given.\n"
          "- Do not say goodbye or end the call yourself: the call is closed for you.\n"
          "- Call at most one tool per message. When a rule says to call a tool, call it: saying it is not enough.\n"
          "- After every tool result, speak to the customer or call the next tool. Never end a turn with nothing. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result.\n"
          "- Say amounts as plain numbers, for example 420.50, and dates as weekday, day and month, for example Friday 16 October.")

wf = fl.assemble(INITIAL, nodes, SYSTEM, [close_call], conduct=True)   # no test_variables (CLAUDE.md); conduct = how customers talk

if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ROOT / "out/brief-b_v3.workflow.json"
    fl.write_workflow(wf, out)
    print("nodes:", len(nodes), "->", out)

def verify_post(question, hints, max_wrong_text,
                all_verified_text="All security questions passed. Identity is verified.",
                verified_text="Correct. Ask the next security question.",
                unreadable_text="The answer could not be read. It does not count as wrong. Ask again: {question}",
                wrong_text="Wrong answer. Tell the customer it does not match our records and ask again: {question}",
                fields=None, stop_left=("0",)):
    """Post hook for one identity question. `hints` maps a response hint value to the text for it (checked first,
    a hint is not a wrong answer). `max_wrong_text` is used when the wrong-answers counter reaches 0.
    `fields` renames the response fields: {"hint", "all_verified", "verified", "ok", "left"}.
    `stop_left` = the wrong_answers_left values at which the check is over (default ("0",), the service's own
    limit). A brief stricter than the service (e.g. "the second wrong answer ends the check" on a service that
    allows three) passes the values that mean "limit reached", e.g. ("1", "0"); route the node on the same values.
    The default texts are generic placeholders: a generator should pass the brief's own wording for every text
    (all_verified_text, verified_text, unreadable_text, wrong_text, max_wrong_text), e.g. what the brief says the
    agent does once identity is verified, how many questions there are, how a wrong answer is worded."""
    f = {"hint": "hint", "all_verified": "all_verified", "verified": "verified", "ok": "ok", "left": "wrong_answers_left"}
    f.update(fields or {})
    q = lambda s: s.replace("{question}", question)
    stops = tuple(str(x) for x in stop_left)
    stop = "str(left) == %r" % stops[0] if len(stops) == 1 else "str(left) in %r" % (stops,)
    branches = [("d.get(%r) == %r" % (f["hint"], v), t) for v, t in (hints or {}).items()]
    branches += [(truthy(f["all_verified"]), all_verified_text), (truthy(f["verified"]), verified_text),
                 (falsy(f["ok"]), q(unreadable_text)), (stop, max_wrong_text)]
    return what_next_post(branches, q(wrong_text), prelude=["left = d.get(%r)" % f["left"]])

    adds vars.setdefault lines to the except block."""

"""Kestrel Bank autumn arrears campaign (brief kestrel.md: email of 6 Oct + CP-7 s.4 + memo of 12 Oct in force from
14 Oct + code list v3). Policy as code on builder/policy.py. Every value in this file comes from that brief/spec."""
import json, pathlib, sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "builder"))
import freyalib as fl  # noqa: E402
import policy as pol  # noqa: E402

API = fl.load_api(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ROOT / "tools/openapi.json")
SPEC = json.load(open(ROOT / "out/kestrel.spec.json"))["spec"]
HOLIDAYS = [h["date"] for h in SPEC["calendar"]["holidays"]]          # R83/R109: CP-7 4.3 + memo item 4 (Founders' Day)
CB = SPEC["callback"]                                                   # R113: 09:00-18:00, today later than now, next 2 business days
BANK = "Kestrel Bank"

nodes = {}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- terminals: code list v3 + memo item 5 (HSHP)
FINS = {
    "promise": ("promise", "PRM", "Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "paid": ("paid", "AP", "Thank you for letting me know, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_restructuring": ("transferred", "TRS", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_human": ("transferred", "TRH", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "transferred_support": ("transferred", "TSP", "Thank you, {{title}} {{last_name}}. A colleague from our customer care team will take over now. Goodbye."),
    "refused": ("no_promise", "RF", "I understand. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "hardship": ("no_promise", "HSHP", "Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}, and take care. Goodbye."),   # memo item 5: HSHP replaces HARD from 14 Oct
    "dispute": ("no_promise", "DSP", "Thank you for telling me. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "service_error": ("no_promise", "SVC", "I am sorry, I could not record that because of a technical problem. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye."),
    "failed": ("not_verified", "IDF", "I am sorry, for security I cannot continue by phone. You can use the Kestrel mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you, goodbye."),
    "declined": ("not_verified", "IDD", "I understand. Nothing can be discussed without the security questions. Thank you for your time, goodbye."),
    "id_service": ("not_verified", "SVC", "I am sorry, a technical problem means I cannot continue. Thank you, goodbye."),
    "callback": ("not_reached", "CBK", "Thank you, we will call back then. Goodbye."),
    "no_callback": ("not_reached", "NCB", "Thank you for your help. Goodbye."),
    "wrong_number": ("not_reached", "WN", "I apologise for the inconvenience. Thank you, goodbye."),
    "deceased": ("not_reached", "DEC", "Please accept my condolences. Goodbye."),
    "unclear": ("not_reached", "UNC", "I am sorry, I could not confirm who I am speaking with. Thank you, goodbye."),
}
for key, (outcome, reason, farewell) in FINS.items():
    fl.end_pair(key, outcome, reason, farewell, nodes)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup: calendar, callback window, default close
SETUP_EXTRA = r'''
vars['outcome'] = 'not_reached'
vars['reason'] = 'UNC'
'''
SETUP = fl.SETUP_CODE(HOLIDAYS, callback_rule={"open": CB["open"], "close": CB["close"], "same_day": bool(CB.get("same_day", True)),
                                               "days_ahead": int(CB.get("days_ahead_business", 2))},
                      extra=SETUP_EXTRA, weekday_rule="first_after_plus7")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- opening (R13-R20)
OPEN_LINE = "This is the digital assistant of Kestrel Bank. Please note that this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{first_name}} {{last_name}}?"
WHO_VALUES = ["customer", "someone_else", "wrong_number", "deceased", "refuses", "unclear"]
WHO_DESC = ("Who answered, judged ONLY from the person's latest message. "
            "customer = they confirm they are {{first_name}} {{last_name}}: 'yes', 'speaking', 'that's me', or they say the customer's own name. "
            "someone_else = another person answered (a relative, partner, flatmate, colleague), or says the customer is not here / not available, or offers to take a message. "
            "wrong_number = says this number does not belong to that person / they do not know them. "
            "deceased = says the customer has died / passed away. "
            "refuses = says they do not want to talk / not interested. "
            "unclear = anything else: 'hello', 'go ahead', 'who's asking', 'what is this about', a question, silence.")
OPENING_ROUTES = [
    ("customer", "ask_phone", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
    ("deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
    ("wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
    ("someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
]
nodes["opening"] = fl.conv(
    "opening",
    "If you have not spoken yet, say exactly: \"" + OPEN_LINE + "\" Do not call any tool in this turn. Do not say why you are calling.",
    on_enter={"type": "tts", "text": OPEN_LINE},
    extraction=[fl.ext("who1", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)], first_only=True)
INITIAL = fl.conversation_first("opening", SETUP, "who1", OPENING_ROUTES, "opening_retry", nodes)

ASIDES_TXT = ("who you are -> 'I am Kestrel Bank's digital assistant.'; a robot or AI -> say exactly \"I am Kestrel Bank's digital assistant.\"; "
              "a scam -> say they are welcome to hang up and call the number on the back of their card or on their statement; "
              "what it is about -> it is a personal banking matter you can only discuss with {{first_name}} {{last_name}}.")
nodes["opening_retry"] = fl.conv(
    "opening_retry",
    "You asked whether you are speaking with {{first_name}} {{last_name}}, but the answer did not confirm it. This is the second and last ask. "
    "No tool call is allowed in this turn. Never say why you are calling; never say arrears, overdue, late, collections, debt, payment, instalment or any product name.\n"
    "If the person asked a question, answer it in one short sentence first: " + ASIDES_TXT + " "
    "If they said they do not want to talk, say this will only take a moment. "
    "Then ask exactly: \"Am I speaking with {{first_name}} {{last_name}}?\"",
    extraction=[fl.ext("who2", WHO_VALUES, WHO_DESC)],
    transitions=[
        fl.eq("who2", "customer", "ask_phone", "the customer confirmed who they are"),
        fl.eq("who2", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "the customer has died"),
        fl.eq("who2", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
        fl.eq("who2", "someone_else", "third_party", "someone else answered"),
        fl.eq("who2", "refuses", "fin_declined", "does not want to talk, said twice"),
        fl.always("fin_unclear"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- third party (R22-R29)
cb_tool = fl.api_tool(
    API, "schedule_callback",
    description="Book a callback for the customer. CALL it as soon as the person names a day and time inside the allowed window.",
    field_descriptions={"date": "Callback date as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be one of the allowed days.",
                        "time": "Callback time as HH:MM, 24 hour, between %s and %s." % (CB["open"], CB["close"])},
    pre=fl.normalise_pre({"date": "date", "time": "time"}, date_order="dmy"),
    post=fl.ok_post("Callback booked.", "The booking failed. Try schedule_callback once more with the same values."))

nodes["third_party"] = fl.conv(
    "third_party",
    "You called for {{title}} {{last_name}} ({{first_name}}) but someone else is on the line.\n"
    "STRICT: Say only that it is a personal banking matter that you can only discuss with {{title}} {{last_name}}, and ask when he or she can be reached. Nothing more. "
    "Never say arrears, overdue, late, collections, debt, payment, instalment or any product name, even if they ask or offer to pay or help: a relative cannot answer security questions, "
    "cannot be told anything about the account and cannot pay on this call; if they offer, decline politely and go back to asking when {{title}} {{last_name}} can be reached.\n"
    "Now: {{today_text}}, {{now_time}}.\n{{callback_text}}\n"
    "- If they give a day and time inside the window, call schedule_callback with date YYYY-MM-DD and time HH:MM. If they give only a day, ask for a time; if only a vague time like 'morning', propose a precise time inside the window and ask if it suits.\n"
    "- If the day or time is outside the window, propose the nearest slot inside it, ONCE (the counter below says whether you already did). "
    "If they do not take it (second answer still outside the window, or they cannot say when), do not book: call transition_to_fin_no_callback.\n"
    "After every tool result, speak or call the next tool.",
    tools=[cb_tool],
    extraction=[fl.ext("tp_status", ["none", "wrong_number", "deceased"],
                       "From the person's latest message: wrong_number if they say this number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer; deceased if they say the customer has died; otherwise none.")],
    transitions=[
        fl.ok_true("schedule_callback", "fin_callback", "callback booked"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "deceased", "fin_deceased", "customer died"),
        fl.eq("tp_status", "wrong_number", "fin_wrong_number", "wrong number"),
        fl.intent_tool("fin_no_callback",
                       "No callback can be booked: the nearest slot inside the window was proposed once and not taken, or the person cannot say when the customer is reachable.",
                       "No callback inside the window"),
    ])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- identity (R30-R37): phone_last4 then date_of_birth, 2 wrong answers end the check
HINTS = {"day_month_swapped": "Day and month look swapped. This is NOT a wrong answer. Ask the customer to repeat the date of birth with the month as a word, for example 14 March 1988."}
MAX_WRONG = "Second wrong answer: the check has ended. Say nothing about the account or the reason for the call."
ALL_VERIFIED = "Both answers are correct. Identity verified."
STOP_LEFT = ("1", "0")   # the service allows three wrong answers; Kestrel ends the check at the second (wrong_answers_left 1)

transfer_general = fl.api_tool(API, "transfer_to_agent", baked={"queue": "general"},
                               description="Transfer the call to a human agent. CALL it straight away when the customer asks for a person; do not ask whether you can help first.")

ID_COMMON = ("Rules for this step:\n"
             "- Never say arrears, overdue, late, collections, debt, payment, instalment or any product name, and never say why you are calling. If asked what the call is about or how much they owe, say you can explain right after the security questions.\n"
             "- If the customer asks a question back (why you need it, who is calling, robot, scam): answer in one short sentence (" + ASIDES_TXT + "), then say that these questions are there to protect their account and nothing can be discussed without them, then ask the same question again.\n"
             "- If the customer asks for a person or a human agent: call transfer_to_agent at once.\n"
             "- After every tool result, speak to the customer or call the next tool. Follow what_to_do_next.")

REFUSAL_DESC = ("From the customer's LATEST message only: refused if they refuse to answer the security question, say they do not want to talk, "
                "or ask AGAIN what the call is about instead of answering (after it was already explained). human if they ask for a person or a human agent. "
                "none if they give an answer or say anything else." + fl.QUESTION_ENUM_CLAUSE + fl.REFUSAL_NONE_CLAUSE)

    "ask_phone",
    "The person confirmed they are {{title}} {{last_name}}; from now on address them as {{title}} {{last_name}}. You must check identity with two security questions, one at a time. "
    "Now ask the first: the last four digits of the phone number the bank holds for them.\n"
    "When they give four digits, call verify_identity with answer = the four digits only. " + fl.latest_value_note(4) + "\n" + ID_COMMON,
    tools=[fl.api_tool(API, "verify_identity", baked={"field": "phone_last4"}, pre=fl.compose_pre(fl.reset_pre(["question_count_phone"]), fl.normalise_pre({"answer": "digits"})) if hasattr(fl, "compose_pre") else fl.normalise_pre({"answer": "digits"}),
                       description="Check the last four digits of the phone number. CALL it every time the customer gives four digits.",
                       field_descriptions={"answer": "Exactly four digits."},
                       post=fl.verify_post("What are the last four digits of the phone number we hold for you?", HINTS, MAX_WRONG, all_verified_text=ALL_VERIFIED,
                                           verified_text="Correct. Now ask the second security question: the date of birth.", stop_left=STOP_LEFT)), transfer_general],
    extraction=[fl.ext("refusal_phone", ["none", "refused", "question", "human"], REFUSAL_DESC)],

items = []
for i, p in enumerate(prods):

    ptype = str(p.get('type') or '')

        try:
            floor = min(2.0 * float(p.get('minimum_payment')), past_due)   # memo item 3: twice the minimum payment, never more than the overdue amount

            floor = past_due
        floor_name = 'twice the minimum payment'
    else:
        words = ptype.replace('_', ' ') if ptype else 'loan'
        try:
            floor = float(p.get('instalment_amount'))               # 4.2
        except Exception:
            floor = past_due

    if 1 <= days_late <= 10:
        d21 = today + datetime.timedelta(days=21)                    # band F: 21 calendar days, last business day before if needed

        rungs = [('full_or_floor', a1)]

        deadline = addbd(today, 5)                                   # band S (and over 45): 5th business day (memo item 1)

    register_product(vars, pid, words, past_due, floor, floor_name, deadline, rungs)

statement = 'Thank you, ' + name + '. I am calling from the arrears team about an overdue payment. '
for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
    statement += 'Your ' + w + ' has an overdue amount of ' + fmt(pd) + ', ' + str(dl_) + ' days overdue. '
if len(items) == 1:
    statement += 'Are you able to clear the overdue amount today?'

lines = []
for w, pd, dl_, dd in items:
    lines.append(w + ': overdue ' + fmt(pd) + ', ' + str(dl_) + ' days overdue, latest date ' + txt_short(dd))
vars['products_facts'] = '; '.join(lines)
vars['outcome'] = 'no_promise'
vars['reason'] = 'RF'
